source.author: ov
source.text: res latuit, priscique manent imitamina facti; aera deae comites raucaque terga movent, cymbala pro galeis, pro scutis tympana pulsant; tibia dat Phrygios, ut dedit ante, modos.
source.text_original: res latuit, priscique manent imitamina facti; / aera deae comites raucaque terga movent, / cymbala pro galeis, pro scutis tympana pulsant; / tibia dat Phrygios, ut dedit ante, modos.'
source.text_english: The matter was concealed, and there remain imitations of the ancient deed; the goddess’s attendants move bronze and their hoarse backs, beating cymbals for helmets and drums for shields; the flute gives Phrygian tunes, as it did before.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: res latuit priscique manent imitamina facti, aera deae comites raucaque terga mouent.
reuse.text_original: res latuit priscique manent imitamina facti, aera deae comites raucaque terga mouent.
reuse.text_english: The affair lay hidden, and there remain imitations of the ancient deed; the attendants of the goddess move the bronze cymbals and their hoarse backs.
